Sikkim monitors glacial lakes, offers GLOF expertise; trekker warns of threat

Sikkim is monitoring 16 high-risk glacial lakes within its territory and has offered its expertise in Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) management to Nepal. Separately, a trekker in Poonch, Jammu and Kashmir, has raised concerns about the threat posed by GLOFs and urged the local government to monitor glacial lakes in the region. The coverage highlights Sikkim's proactive measures and a trekker's warning about potential GLOF dangers.
